writing.overall_comment: Accurate and mostly actionable as a prompt-style skill, but it would be stronger if the linked reference content were inlined and the duplicated/typo-ridden sections were cleaned up.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and description accurately identify an enterprise Java/Spring development guidance skill, matching the broad persona, principles, and task patterns in the body.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: The document includes useful N+1, OOM, architecture, and code-review examples, but key templates, best practices, and pitfalls are only linked to an external file and some edge-case coverage is shallow.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: It gives clear response formats and step sequences for common task types, yet several actionable sections are stubs pointing to references, reducing standalone executability.

suggestions: In the actionable sections that are currently stubs, replace reference-only pointers with concrete standalone steps or checklists for each common task type.
In the templates, best practices, and pitfalls sections, inline the essential content currently linked to the external file so the document is executable without it.
In the examples section, add concrete edge-case examples alongside the existing N+1, OOM, architecture, and code-review examples to deepen shallow coverage.
